author: Andrew Fisher
scope: Exact extracted candidate satellite/session functions, controlled fetch and bitmap promises, and a fake clock. No browser, network or service calls.
limits: These checks cover request ownership, retry state, slot accounting and cache bounds. They do not establish rendering quality, real network behaviour or device performance.

checks.name: Stale provider decode closes its bitmap and cannot replace a newer tile
Stale provider error cannot clear a renewed session or downgrade its source
Intentional cancellation records no failed tile or retry attempt
Pruning a decode in the same generation closes and rejects its late bitmap
Failed tile and retry caches stay bounded on phone
Failed tile and retry caches stay bounded on desktop
Cancel releases eight hung slots immediately and late finally cannot release newer slots
Explicit Retry immediately releases all eight pending tile slots
Twenty-second deadlines release pending slots and register retryable failures
Concurrent Google session callers share one request
Google session 503 recovers through explicit Retry
Google session deadline settles and explicit Retry can start a fresh session
